description: This Java class, RequireNameValidator, implements Spring's Validator interface to ensure that objects have a non-empty, non-whitespace 'name' property. It's used as a utility validator in the OpenMRS project to enforce the presence of 'name' fields in validated objects.

classes.name: RequireNameValidator
classes.description: A Spring Validator implementation that checks whether an object has a non-empty 'name' property and supports validation if such a property exists.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if the validator supports validating objects of the given class by checking for a 'name' property with getter and setter.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the object, rejecting if the 'name' property is null, empty, or whitespace.
